title: Aligning Medical Vision Language Models at the Capability Boundary with Entropy Adaptive Rubric Grounding
abstract: arXiv:2610.39835v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical diagnostic reasoning requires verifiable links between visual evidence and clinical knowledge, yet current medical vision language models are aligned with objectives that reward the wrong behavior. Uniform supervised fine tuning lets easy cases dominate updates while clinically critical boundary cases saturate prematurely. Sparse rewards based only on final-answer correctness cannot assess anatomical grounding or clinical logic, inviting reward hacking through answer shortcuts. We propose MedCBR, a two-stage alignment framework coupling boundary-aware preference optimization with rubric-grounded reinforcement learning. First, we construct counterfactual boundary preferences at the model's capability frontier using empirical pass rates and preference pairs that share reasoning prefixes but diverge at decisive diagnostic branches. Difficulty Weighted Boundary Preference Optimization (DBPO) concentrates learning on this calibrated

translated_title: 基于熵自适应评分标准锚定的医学视觉语言模型能力边界对齐
translated_abstract: 医学诊断推理需要视觉证据与临床知识之间可验证的联系，然而当前医学视觉语言模型所对齐的目标却会奖励错误的行为。统一的监督微调使简单案例主导模型更新，而临床上关键的边界案例却过早饱和。仅基于最终答案正确性的稀疏奖励无法评估解剖学依据或临床逻辑，容易通过答案捷径引发奖励欺骗。我们提出MedCBR，这是一个将边界感知偏好优化与评分标准锚定强化学习相结合的两阶段对齐框架。首先，我们使用经验通过率以及共享推理前缀但在决定性诊断分支处产生分歧的偏好对，在模型的能力前沿构建反事实边界偏好。难度加权边界偏好优化（DBPO）将学习集中于这个经校准的
tldr: 该论文提出MedCBR两阶段对齐框架，通过难度加权边界偏好优化与评分标准锚定的强化学习，在模型能力边界处对齐医学视觉语言模型，以提升可验证的诊断推理能力。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes MedCBR, a two-stage alignment framework combining difficulty-weighted boundary preference optimization with rubric-grounded reinforcement learning to align medical vision language models at their capability boundary for verifiable diagnostic reasoning.
